jobs.title: Director, Analytics & Insights
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p>Harborview Health runs 14 hospitals across the Southeast.</p></div><h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2><ul><li>Build and lead the demand forecasting function across our hospitals.</li><li>Lead a team of 10-15 analysts and data scientists.</li><li>Partner with clinical and operations leaders to turn analysis into decisions.</li></ul><h2>What you bring</h2><ul><li>10+ years in analytics, 5+ leading teams.</li><li>Experience with clinical or operational data in a health system.</li><li>SQL, Python and a modern BI stack (Looker or Tableau).</li></ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Pay range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$190,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$225,000 USD</span></div></div></div><p>We also offer a $10,000 signing bonus and a 401(k) match.</p>

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (Remote)
jobs.content: <p>Design pipelines for clinical data. The salary range for this role is $150K - $175K.</p><p>Experience with dbt and Airflow.</p>
